answer: Paying 50 stamped dockets, each costing $12 to have checked is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The counter asks for Avowed spinner vat token first, and a token spinners wear after loom inspections is the answer it accepts. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. sonnet stays on the record. violet is written on the receipt. The oasis is on the docket.
